short: A delivery-only kitchen with no dining area.
seoTitle: Cloud Kitchen — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: A cloud kitchen is a delivery-only operation with no dining room and no walk-in trade. The model trades rent and service labour for commission and packaging.
definition: A cloud kitchen is a delivery-only operation with no dining room and no walk-in trade. It sells entirely through aggregators or its own ordering channel, often running several brands from the same kitchen.
bodyHtml:
Why Cloud Kitchen matters

The model trades rent and service labour for commission and packaging. Whether that is a better deal depends entirely on order volume and how much of it comes through your own channel rather than a platform.

How Cloud Kitchen works in practice

Watch commission as a share of revenue and the share of orders that are direct. Multiple brands from one kitchen raise utilisation but complicate stock and station planning.

faq.question: Are cloud kitchens cheaper to run?
faq.answer: Lower rent and service labour, but higher commission, packaging and marketing spend — the net depends on your channel mix.

faq.question: Do cloud kitchens need a POS?
faq.answer: Yes. Order aggregation, KOT routing and per-brand reporting are harder without one, not easier.
